component.name: Steam Manifest Downloader
component.summary: Download Steam game depots and manifests via a modern GUI

description.p: Steam Manifest Downloader is a desktop GUI for downloading Steam game depots and manifests that the user already legitimately owns. The application is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve Corporation, does not include or distribute Steam keys or licenses, and does not bypass any DRM or copy protection. It is intended for archival, backup and similar legitimate use cases involving content the user has the right to access.

Drop a .lua / .st file or search by App ID, pick the depots you want, and the app handles manifest fetching, depot key generation and the actual download in one step. Built with Tauri v2, a Rust backend, and a vanilla JavaScript frontend.

ul.li: Drag and drop .lua / .st parsing
Search by App ID via Internet Archive
Automatic depot key generation
Real-time progress with download speed and ETA
Steam Store integration for game names and cover art
Dark and light themes, download history
Embedded DepotDownloaderMod, no .NET runtime needed on Linux
